definition: Eligible/observable primary mHSPC cohort without qualifying treatment initiation by day 90.
proxy_limitation: Synthetic governed eligibility and normalized treatment start; not clinical eligibility.

definition: 60-day permissible-gap persistence failure by day 365; competing events before day 365 excluded.
proxy_limitation: Gap-based endpoint is assumption-dependent and dispensing is not ingestion.

definition: Explicit switch by day 365 versus remaining event-free through day 365; early competing events excluded.
proxy_limitation: Conditional risk set excludes early competing events and is not treatment effectiveness.

definition: Temporary gap with observed restart versus non-restarted discontinuation among 60-day gap failures by day 365.
proxy_limitation: Conditional on an observed/assumed 60-day gap failure; threshold-dependent.

definition: Exact complement of non_initiated_within_90_days in the same risk set.
proxy_limitation: A duplicate model would contain identical information with reversed signs.
